comment: Skipped on rri-mtest: RRI requires a holder, so a domain cannot be without a registrant. Review: registrant.min_count stands in for 'authInfo is required at create', which RRI does not require; the fact named is not the subject.
description: The data objects allow a domain without authInfo (0-1); RFC 5731 requires one at create, which the registry refuses as a missing parameter.
